current_evidence: The council's 'Planning - validation requirements' A-Z page still offers only this 'validation requirements' download (file 1558), whose text says 'Last updated February 2024' (nutrient calculator and BNG added). No newer or consultation list was found.

issues.detail: The source is organised by application type, but Grokbot shows '(none)' for several types that do have local requirements. Reserved matters has location plan matching the outline, competent person statement, DAS, nutrient calculator, Fire Statement, archaeology, energy/water statement, FRA, landscape, transport, SCI and CIL form. Listed building consent has a PEA for roof conversion or removal. Lawful development cert has a CIL form for increases in non-residential GIA. Variation of condition has a Deed of Variation where an S106/UU exists, plus condition-specific assessments. Non-material amendment needs a full set of proposed plans. Discharge of conditions needs the nutrient calculator for pre-commencement conditions. Other prior notifications need the nutrient calculator, Fire Statement and GIRAMS payment.

Transport Assessment/Statement and Travel Plan are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The source's section is 'Change of Use (no physical/operational development)', a full planning application rather than a prior approval, and the same thresholds also apply to Full, Outline and Reserved matters. The other roughly 20 items under Full planning are marked 'INFERRED' even though the source names the application type explicitly in each section.
issues.evidence: Section 2 'Change of Use (no physical/operational development)'; Section 3 transport thresholds table

issues.detail: Local requirements not captured: GIRAMS payment secured by a unilateral undertaking, which must be completed to validate (any net increase in dwellings including student and tourist accommodation); Energy, water and construction statement (10+ dwellings or 1,000 sqm+ non-residential); Landscape assessment and design statement (10+ dwellings or 1,000 sqm+); Competent person statement (where the BNG gain condition applies); Deed of Variation (s73 where the original permission had an S106/UU); Main town centre sequential assessment (new main town centre uses outside centres, or retail/leisure extensions over 200 sqm); Retail/leisure impact assessment (over 1,000 sqm outside centres); CIL Additional Information Form for full applications (one or more dwellings or any increase in non-residential GIA).
issues.grok_comment: Several of the listed items are in the workbook. The Planning Obligations row quotes the GIRAMS unilateral undertaking text, the Water efficiency row quotes the Energy, water and construction statement (10+ dwellings/1,000 sqm), and the Retail/Town Centre row quotes the main town centre uses sequential assessment.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. GIRAMS, energy/water and sequential test are partly captured under other rows. Any other missing items stand.

issues.detail: Several triggers come from the wrong passage or are fragments. Block plan / Site plan and Schedule of works (listed building) both use the demolition prior-approval text ('a demolition method statement, and a site plan indicating proposed remediation...'). Heritage Statement uses archaeology text. Sequential/Exception Test is just 'of the sequential test.'. Contaminated Land begins with '5 pitches' from the transport table. Retail/Town Centre is guidance text with no threshold. Archaeology omits the actual triggers: Area of Main Archaeological Interest sites not predominantly built on, sites flagged at pre-app, and sites of 1ha+.
issues.evidence: Block plan trigger: 'statement, and a site plan indicating proposed remediation and how the site is to be left following demolition.'

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' tab items are process text rather than requirements: email submission address, acceptable file types (JPG/TIF/PDF...), 10Mb file-size limit, no zipped files, 'Any unspent monies will be returned to the applicant', and pre-application advice on viability. 'LOCAL REQUIREMENTS None Where possible please submit plans and photographs...' is advice from the demolition prior notification and is filed as a drawing standard.
issues.evidence: 'Individual file sizes must be 10Mb or less.'; 'Any unspent monies will be returned to the applicant.'

summary: Grokbot's link is to the current Norwich validation requirements (last updated February 2024), and the date is correct. Its extraction misses key local items such as GIRAMS/UU, the energy-water-construction statement, landscape statement and Deed of Variation, and wrongly shows '(none)' for Reserved matters, LBC, LDC, s73, NMA and Discharge even though the source lists local requirements for each. Several triggers come from unrelated passages.
